scope_guards: A garden community label is not treated as an adopted allocation.
A vision is not treated as an agreed masterplan.
A governance board is not treated as a delivery vehicle with funding.
A planning strategy is not treated as permission.
A stewardship proposal is not treated as an endowed management body.
An infrastructure plan is not treated as completed infrastructure.
A housing trajectory is not treated as occupied homes.
No score or promotion is written without policy, land, finance, consent, construction, occupation and stewardship evidence.
